value.rationale: The theorem exactly quantifies the finite-sampling penalty relative to a classical continuous Sidon constant for every even cyclic order, with an explicit extremizer and asymptotic limit. This is a natural all-parameter harmonic-analysis invariant, not an arbitrary finite instance.

final_claim: For every even \(N\ge4\), the Sidon constant of the three consecutive characters \(\{0,1,2\}\subset\widehat{\mathbb Z_N}\) is \(\sqrt{1+\sec^2(\pi/N)}\).
limitations: Even cyclic orders only; odd orders and arbitrary three-character subsets are not classified.
